                            canonical_lf_sha256=ALLOWED['tests/test_h_extrema_contracts.py'][0]) for n in LINEAGE]
    assert record['historical_test_lineage'] == expected_lineage, 'different historical H lineage'
    assert set(record['files']) == set(current) == set(ALLOWED), 'unlisted H source mismatch'
    for name, (expected, names) in ALLOWED.items():
        entry = record['files'][name]
        assert set(entry) == {'original_source_utf8', 'original_raw_sha256', 'original_canonical_lf_sha256',
                              'current_raw_sha256', 'current_canonical_lf_sha256', 'body_replacements'}
        original = entry['original_source_utf8'].encode('utf-8')
        raw = current[name]
        assert sha(original) == entry['original_raw_sha256'] == expected, 'wrong H historical capture'
        assert sha(original.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')) == entry['original_canonical_lf_sha256']
        assert sha(raw) == entry['current_raw_sha256'], 'H current source hash differs'
        assert sha(raw.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')) == entry['current_canonical_lf_sha256']
        assert [r['name'] for r in entry['body_replacements']] == list(names), 'unlisted H metadata body'
        old_tree, new_tree = ast.parse(original), ast.parse(raw)
        inverse = raw
        for replacement in entry['body_replacements']:
            assert set(replacement) == {'name', 'original_body_utf8', 'current_body_utf8'}
            before = replacement['original_body_utf8'].encode('utf-8')
            after = replacement['current_body_utf8'].encode('utf-8')
            assert before == _body(original, old_tree, replacement['name'])
            assert after == _body(raw, new_tree, replacement['name'])
            assert original.count(before) == raw.count(after) == 1
            inverse = inverse.replace(after, before, 1)
        assert inverse == original, 'H change outside permitted metadata bodies'
        # Raw inverse protects every non-body byte and all source positions.
        # This second check retains every semantic AST field on the SAME runtime.
        restored = copy.deepcopy(new_tree)
        for node in restored.body:
            if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in names:
                node.body = copy.deepcopy(next(n for n in old_tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == node.name).body)
        assert ast.dump(restored, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(old_tree, include_attributes=False)
    return True

def assert_check_linux_fenv_setup(workflow, sdk_source):
    blocks = jobs(workflow)
    block = blocks['check']
    marker = '      - name: Prepare the Linux floating-point test helper\n'
    assert workflow.count(marker) == 1 and marker in block
    before, rest = block.split(marker)
    helper, _, after = rest.partition('\n      - ')
    assert 'actions/setup-python@v5' in before
    assert helper.startswith("        if: runner.os == 'Linux'\n        shell: bash\n")
    assert 'set -euo pipefail' in helper
    build = 'python tests/util_views_fenv_build.py --output "$bundle" --control-python "$(command -v python)"'
    assert 'bundle="$PWD/build/ci-artifacts/util-views-fenv"' in helper
    assert helper.index(build) < helper.index('PASS_SOURCE_BUILT_FENV32') < helper.index('GITHUB_ENV')
    assert 'assert hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == record[\'files\'][helper.name]' in helper
    for line in (
        "'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_MODE': 'source-built-v1'",
        "'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_RECEIPT': receipt",
        "'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_RECEIPT_SHA256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()",
        "'SKIMAGEXX_FENV_HELPER': helper",
    ):
        assert helper.count(line) == 1
    assert 'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_HELPER' not in helper
    assert 'test_join_segmentations_public.py' not in before and after.count('test_join_segmentations_public.py') == 2
    assert 'tools/check_installed_pytest.py' not in before
    assert_check_broad_modes(after)
    assert 'tools/check_cmake_install.py' not in before and after.count('tools/check_cmake_install.py') == 2
    assert 'build/ci-artifacts/' in after[after.index('name: parity-package-'):]
    for name, body in blocks.items():
        if name != 'check':
            assert 'tests/util_views_fenv_build.py' not in body and 'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_MODE' not in body
    assert "fenv_helper=os.environ.get('SKIMAGEXX_FENV_HELPER')" in sdk_source
    assert "if fenv_helper:common.append(f'-DSKIMAGEXX_FENV_HELPER={fenv_helper}')" in sdk_source

def assert_check_linux_fenv_setup(workflow, sdk_source):
    blocks = jobs(workflow)
    block = blocks['check']
    marker = '      - name: Prepare the Linux floating-point test helper\n'
    assert workflow.count(marker) == 1 and marker in block
    before, rest = block.split(marker)
    helper, _, after = rest.partition('\n      - ')
    assert 'actions/setup-python@v5' in before
    assert helper.startswith("        if: runner.os == 'Linux'\n        shell: bash\n")
    assert 'set -euo pipefail' in helper
    build = 'python tests/util_views_fenv_build.py --output "$bundle" --control-python "$(command -v python)"'
    assert 'bundle="$PWD/build/ci-artifacts/util-views-fenv"' in helper
    assert helper.index(build) < helper.index('PASS_SOURCE_BUILT_FENV32') < helper.index('GITHUB_ENV')
    assert 'assert hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == record[\'files\'][helper.name]' in helper
    for line in (
        "'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_MODE': 'source-built-v1'",
        "'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_RECEIPT': receipt",
        "'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_RECEIPT_SHA256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()",
        "'SKIMAGEXX_FENV_HELPER': helper",
    ):
        assert helper.count(line) == 1
    assert 'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_HELPER' not in helper
    assert 'test_join_segmentations_public.py' not in before and after.count('test_join_segmentations_public.py') == 2
    assert 'tools/check_installed_pytest.py' not in before
    assert_check_broad_modes(after)
    assert 'tools/check_cmake_install.py' not in before and after.count('tools/check_cmake_install.py') == 2
    assert 'build/ci-artifacts/' in after[after.index('name: parity-package-'):]
    for name, body in blocks.items():
        if name != 'check':
            assert 'tests/util_views_fenv_build.py' not in body and 'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_MODE' not in body
    assert "fenv_helper=os.environ.get('SKIMAGEXX_FENV_HELPER')" in sdk_source
    assert "if fenv_helper:common.append(f'-DSKIMAGEXX_FENV_HELPER={fenv_helper}')" in sdk_source
    assert "run('configure',['-S',root/'tests/cmake_consumer','-B',consumer,*common])" in sdk_source

    tree = ast.parse(driver)
